At 1002 it closed on the butt end of the handle (handle diagonal across the finger gap) and lifted 0.10 m; the knife pivoted around the contact and slid out at ~1032-1040 (fingers shut to 0.003), falling back into the drawer. It came back to the drawer (1300), grasped the handle again at 1363 (lift 0.087), and the knife again slid out at ~1390-1400 and fell into the drawer. It then hovered over the knife with closed fingers until 1600. The meat was never touched.
